_comment: Copy to data/bullet-library.json and replace with your real bullets. The role-keys (current / prior1 / prior2 / prior3 / sideproject) are arbitrary names — what matters is that companyKeyMap maps your resume-baseline.json experience[].company strings to role-keys here, and that bulletCounts in your spec uses the same keys.

current.text: Built and operate the embedding + retrieval platform: FastAPI service exposing /v1/embeddings (nomic-embed-text-v1.5, L2-normalized server-side), hybrid retrieval (vector + BM25 with MMR re-ranking), 20K-entry vector store at sub-200ms p95, serving 9 production applications.

Shipped a 5M-user discrete-time complementary log-log survival model with cross-fitted propensity scores, IPW, propensity matching (0.1 caliper), Doubly Robust AIPW, and Rosenbaum sensitivity bounds, producing actionable findings reshaping marketing-spend allocation.

Architected a 4-stage deterministic agent pipeline (chosen over LLM router per Cemri MAST 2503.13657 / Agentless 2407.01489) threading a typed blackboard across 5 specialized skills, collapsing a previously week-long manual process into one same-day automated brief at 8-15 min wall-clock.

Engineered a 4-hook output safety layer (prompt injection, tool allowlist, two-pass deterministic regex + LLM review over PII / E.164 / email / UUID / credential patterns, risk-scored cancellation): cheap regex catches 85% of violations at zero marginal cost, LLM review reserved for edge cases.

Built a multi-model forecasting orchestration platform (SARIMAX, Holt-Winters, ensemble, panel ML) across 4 business divisions, 700+ forecast paths, with adaptive tier-based config, particle-filter MCMC, and multi-level parallelism.

prior1.text: Led a 4-channel marketing-mix model with Bayesian regularization across $X annual ad spend, producing budget-allocation recommendations adopted by 3 brand teams and shifting Y% of spend toward higher-ROAS channels.

Designed a 4-classifier lookalike audience benchmark (logistic regression / XGBoost / LightGBM / FFNN) with cross-validated calibration, deployed across N campaigns and replacing ad-platform default targeting.

prior2.text: Rebuilt the lead-scoring pipeline: from 200 to 2,000 qualified leads / month, $1M+ incremental revenue attributed.

prior3.text: Built loan-portfolio default-risk models in Python and Excel VBA across $X portfolio.

selectedProjects.text: Built and operate an autonomous multi-cron platform serving a 3-client fleet at $X / month total cost, with operations / outreach / intelligence / ops-center surfaces on a shared runtime.
